doc.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Tunes he doesn't know at jam sessions
summary: If he doesn't know a tune he says so and lets someone else play it.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Well if I don’t know it I tell them I don’t know that.
That’s right. I don’t know that.
Well that’s good rather than try to fumble your way through it.
You have to really know, you know after I go over it a few times — but on the spur of the moment I don’t do that. If I don’t know it I don’t play it. Let somebody else play it who knows it.
